context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 21 verified Owner OAuth Registration via Invitation fixes: (1) InviteAccept.js handleGoogleAuth stores invitation_token in sessionStorage before redirect, (2) AuthCallback retrieves and sends token to backend, (3) exchange_session now updates EXISTING users' company_id, role, and assigned_properties when they have valid invitation, (4) New OAuth users get assigned_properties from invitation, (5) Dashboard KPIs, properties list, bookings list, revenue trends all filter by user.assigned_properties for owner role, (6) Password registration also correctly assigns properties from invitation. The critical bug where owners couldn't register via Google OAuth and saw 0 values in dashboard is FIXED.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The exchange_session endpoint (server.py line 397-535) was not updating existing users with invitation data. When an existing Google user had a valid invitation, the code only updated their name/picture but skipped company_id, role, and assigned_properties. Additionally, assigned_properties was never being set for new OAuth users.
reproduction_steps: 1. Create invitation for owner with assigned_properties
2. User clicks Google OAuth button on invite page
3. User already has existing Google account in system (or creates new one)
4. After OAuth, user's company_id, role, assigned_properties were NOT updated from invitation
5. Dashboard shows 0 values because properties filtering uses assigned_properties which was empty
fix_implemented: 1. InviteAccept.js now stores invitation_token in sessionStorage before OAuth redirect (line 72)
2. AuthCallback.js retrieves token and sends to /api/auth/session (line 24-31)
3. exchange_session now checks for valid invitation BEFORE handling existing/new user logic (line 413-436)
4. For EXISTING users with valid invitation: updates company_id, role, assigned_properties, marks invitation used (line 452-474)
5. For NEW users with valid invitation: sets assigned_properties from invitation (line 487, 514)
